title: WE'RE LOOKING FOR WORLD CHANGERS
summary: Wonna help change the world in a meaningful and impactful manner? Come work with us in uniting humanity towards a brighter future!
body:
Have you ever felt like the world could be better if everyone stood together? We agree with you and want to help humanity evolve together - our main philosophy! 

Helix is here to help everyone, from NGOs to businesses, participate actively in changing the world and make it profitable and impactful! 

We believe it is important for everyone to participate in the making of a better world, including those who just started. Which is why we provide services essential to develop their professional activity such as professional advice, higher visibility and outreach, networking opportunities, and a lot more - all completely for free.

We’re looking to make this organization a Hub where anyone can participate in creating a better world and grow their professional activity faster and better.
To bring this to a reality, we’re looking for people to fulfil many different positions :

 - Head of Operations (managing relationships with costumers, managing our primary financial project, etc….)

 - Head of Visibility Office (managing social media, website, advertisement campaigns, facilitating networking events, radio station and discord server, etc….)

 - Advisors/Liaison Officers (our personalised costumer service for managing relationships with clients in their Member Portfolio and participate in projects and missions when assigned to task forces)

 - HR Agents (handle the normal hiring, training, firing and exceptional situations, maintaining a complex training system that ensures our volunteers actually learn and that ensures the quality of their work)

 - Creative Team members (Videographer, Graphic Designer, Campaign Manager, etc…)


These are some of the many roles that we have available and we have a lot more. Our organization is highly complex, our environment is dynamic and our work is professional. 

If want to make a real change in the world, come work for the Helix Anthropis Institute.

Helix Anthropis Institute. Trust us with your impact.
